scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation in a pink floral dress with green and lavender details, [X] compares several shoe-color directions, tests whether platform heels preserve a formal-glamorous balance, and ultimately commits to strappy platforms that coordinate without overpowering the dress.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 毕业时将穿带绿色和薰衣草色细节的粉色花卉礼服，[X]会比较数种鞋履配色，检验厚底高跟鞋能否维持正式而华丽的平衡，最后选定既协调又不压过礼服的细带厚底鞋。
examples: using Beige, Tan, Camel, Gold, Rose Gold, or Silver for quiet coordination
using Pink, Purple, Green, Coral, or Clear only when the result remains formal rather than costume-like
rejecting a colorway that competes with the floral dress even if the shoe shape is attractive

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Starting from army-green suits already fixed for the wedding party, [X] compares shoe colors against tuxedo or regular-suit formality and matching accessories once the formal dress code is confirmed, then settles on one formal pair as the safest cohesive choice.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从婚礼团队既定的军绿色西装出发，在正式着装要求确认后，[X]会把鞋色与礼服或普通西装的正式程度及配套饰件一并比较，最终选定一双最稳妥、协调的正式鞋。
examples: using Black or Charcoal when evening formality and dark accessories dominate
using Chocolate, Chestnut, or deep Brown only when the regular suit permits a softer alternative
rejecting Tan, Camel, Wheat, or bright colors when they make the fixed formal outfit look too casual

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an informal afternoon reunion on a former college campus, [X] repeatedly checks whether familiar classic clogs can remain in a sweater-and-dark-jeans outfit, with cleanliness and a restrained color determining whether the casual pair looks intentional.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加母校校园里的非正式下午同学会时，[X]会反复确认常穿的经典洞洞鞋能否继续搭配毛衣和深色牛仔裤；鞋子的洁净程度和克制配色决定这双休闲鞋看起来是否经过认真选择。
examples: keeping Black, Navy, Gray, Charcoal, Brown, Beige, or Olive when the familiar pair looks neat
testing White only if visible wear and dirt do not undermine the outfit
rejecting Red, Orange, Yellow, Pink, Purple, or Coral when the user wants the footwear to recede

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing an owned pair of shoes for online resale, [X] cleans it, photographs every side and flaw, and writes a listing whose color description must agree with the images under ordinary lighting to prevent buyer disputes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备把一双自有鞋履放到网上转售时，[X]会先清洁鞋子并拍摄各个角度与瑕疵，再撰写商品描述；其中对颜色的准确表述必须与普通光线下的照片一致，以减少争议。
examples: distinguishing Black from Charcoal, White from Beige, or Brown from Chocolate and Chestnut in the listing
recording Blue, Green, Red, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, or Coral without oversaturating the photographs
showing Gold, Rose Gold, Silver, Copper, or Clear sections separately when reflective or transparent areas photograph differently

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While choosing between familiar retro sneakers and newer low-profile ballet sneakers, [X] compares how each model works with existing jeans, trousers, skirts, and trend-forward outfits, then treats colorway as the final source of versatility or deliberate contrast.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在熟悉的复古运动鞋与更新颖的低帮芭蕾风运动鞋之间犹豫时，[X]会比较两种鞋型与现有牛仔裤、西裤、半身裙和潮流造型的适配，再把配色作为决定百搭性或有意反差的最后因素。
examples: using Black, White, Gray, Beige, Navy, Brown, or Tan when the pair must work across most existing outfits
using Red, Blue, Green, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, or Coral when the new silhouette should create contrast
keeping Olive, Camel, Wheat, Chocolate, or Chestnut when an earth-toned colorway broadens rather than duplicates the closet

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a brown dress already owned, [X] searches for white garden-wedding shoes and revises the shortlist around wide feet, no pinching, grass stability, long wear, finish, and whether nearby light or metallic colorways preserve the intended contrast.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]已有一条棕色礼服，正在寻找花园婚礼用的白鞋，随后依据宽脚不夹脚、草地稳定性、长时间穿着、表面效果，以及相近浅色或金属色能否保留预期反差来重整候选。
examples: retaining White when wide-fit and terrain requirements are met
considering Beige, Clear, Gold, Rose Gold, or Silver when they preserve a light celebratory contrast
rejecting an otherwise suitable color when dirt visibility or outdoor maintenance becomes unacceptable

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B concert at a dry stadium with an outfit already chosen, [X] compares supportive sneakers and broken-in boots across concrete ramps, steep stairs, standing, dancing, phone security, changing temperature, metal accessories, and their appearance in crowd photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为天气干燥的体育场 R&B 演唱会做准备、且已有满意服装时，[X]会在支撑性运动鞋与磨合过的靴子之间比较，兼顾混凝土坡道、陡梯、久站、跳舞、手机安全、温差、金属饰件及人群照片中的整体效果。
examples: using Black, White, Gray, Charcoal, Brown, Tan, Beige, Navy, or Olive for a familiar pair that recedes
using Blue, Green, Red, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, or Coral when one clean colorway should carry the outfit
using Gold, Rose Gold, Silver, or Copper detail only when it coordinates with jewelry and clear-bag hardware

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While packing for five days across Rome, Florence, and Venice, [X] limits footwear to broken-in walking shoes plus an optional dressier pair and checks which color family can repeat across a compact neutral wardrobe without becoming impractical on cobblestones.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为罗马、佛罗伦萨和威尼斯五日行程打包时，[X]会把鞋履限制为磨合过的步行鞋和一双可选的较正式鞋，并检查哪种配色能在精简的中性色衣橱中反复搭配，同时适应鹅卵石路。
examples: using Black, White, Navy, Beige, Gray, Tan, Brown, Charcoal, Olive, Camel, or Wheat for maximum reuse
using Blue, Green, Red, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, or Coral only when the compact wardrobe still coordinates
reserving Gold, Rose Gold, Silver, Copper, or Clear for the optional dressier pair rather than the main walking shoe

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a hot Italian holiday, [X] searches sustainable European retailers for breathable canvas sneakers or leather sandals that survive long cobblestone days, resist a synthetic look, and coordinate with chic shorts and tops already chosen for the trip.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为炎热的意大利假期寻找可持续的欧洲品牌时，[X]会在透气帆布运动鞋和皮凉鞋之间比较，要求它们能承受长时间鹅卵石步行、避免塑料感，并与已选的利落短裤和上衣协调。
examples: using White, Beige, Tan, Brown, Camel, Wheat, Olive, Navy, or Black for a natural-material travel wardrobe
using Blue, Green, Red, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, or Coral when the shoe remains reusable across the trip
rejecting metallic or clear finishes when they conflict with the requested natural-material, low-sweat direction

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While training for a first 10K and declining an in-store fitting, [X] uses home measurements, foot type, cushioning, brand charts, reviews, and return policies to create an online shortlist, then compares colorways only among pairs that pass injury-prevention and fit checks.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 备战首个十公里跑、又拒绝到店试穿时，[X]会利用居家测量、足型、缓震、品牌尺码表、评价和退货政策建立网购候选，只在通过伤病预防与合脚检查的鞋款之间比较配色。
examples: using Black, Gray, Charcoal, Brown, Navy, Chocolate, or Chestnut for repeated training wear
using White, Beige, Tan, Camel, Olive, or Wheat for a lighter or earth-toned qualified pair
using Blue, Green, Red, Pink, Purple, Yellow, Orange, Coral, metallic, or Clear details only after technical qualification

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A candidate interviewing for a managerial role at an industry association assembles a business-formal outfit intended to signal calm leadership and external representation, coordinating polished dress shoes with a dark suit, shirt, tie, belt, and the organization's expected level of formality.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名应聘行业协会管理岗位的候选人准备商务正式造型，希望传达沉稳领导力和对外代表性，并把抛光正装鞋与深色西装、衬衫、领带、腰带及该组织预期的正式程度统一起来。
examples: using Black, dark Brown, Chocolate, Chestnut, or restrained Navy when the organization expects conventional formality
rejecting bright, metallic, or transparent footwear when it distracts from managerial presentation
keeping belt and shoe colors coherent without inventing a company-mandated uniform
